en: A colorized portrait postcard showing a uniformed officer in elaborate dress with a tall white plumed helmet and many decorations. He stands in the center framed by a decorative border. At the top there is Greek text and a red star. At the bottom, flanked by olive branches, are two Greek flags crossed beneath a royal crown, with the years 1821 and 1912 on either side and Greek words along the lower edge.
